items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: All through my life, Vivaldi is, and Bach, our favorite music.

ctx.x: I’m curious, did you listen to a lot of Bach and Vivaldi as a child?

Um hum, yes. All through my life, Vivaldi is, and Bach, our favorite music. Because we listen to mostly classical music, and jazz. And not all jazz, and not all classical, but a bit of each. We also are totally enamored of the bossa nova that came in the 60’s, and we’ve been down to Brazil, and they don’t do that anymore.

Well they do it but rarely, you’d have to search for it. Now it used to be all over. The first time we went down there was in the 60’s, and boy you could just go to so many different clubs and hear the greatest music. But then when we went back a few years ago we went back and we worked down in São Paolo, and we were down there for a couple of weeks and it was hard to find good bossa nova. I’m sure it’s there, it’s like jazz.
